narrative.summary: One bare EOA, delegated to a contract through EIP-7702, is the only DEFAULT_ADMIN of the upgradeable bridge controller that holds ISSUER_ROLE on pathUSD, USDB and DLUSD, so a single key can replace the minting logic of all three.
narrative.tag: composite 9, the lowest on Tempo: about $132M of combined supply under one key
narrative.detail: Traced live on 2026-09-20 on two RPCs: the ISSUER_ROLE holder is the UUPS AccessControlEnumerable controller 0x8354D80E…9058, which has exactly one DEFAULT_ADMIN member, 0x79C6631F…4a4E (code is an EIP-7702 delegation designator, 7 transactions), with no timelock and no Safe in front of it. pathUSD is also the token the chain itself runs on for gas. The 10/15/0 score is therefore not a placeholder: it is what a single uncontested bare key scores. Supply read on 2026-09-20: pathUSD about $50.4M, USDB about $78.1M, DLUSD about $3.5M. USDB (idx 4) and DLUSD (idx 7) share the same controller and key, which is why cross-exposure reads 60.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
